nodes.description: Admin address of the delegator, stored in GovernorBravoDelegatorStorage; gates implementation upgrades.
Address of the implementation contract that receives all delegatecalls from the delegator.
GovernorBravoDelegator constructor: sets admin to msg.sender, delegates initialize call to implementation, then sets final admin.
Admin-only function updating the implementation address; contains require(msg.sender == admin) access check.
Internal helper performing callee.delegatecall(data) and reverting with raw return data on failure.
Internal fallback performing implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) and forwarding returndata via assembly.
External payable fallback entry point that delegates to _fallback.
External payable receive entry point that delegates to _fallback.
Caller-controlled address used to set admin in the constructor and checked in _setImplementation.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) executed inside delegateTo on an arbitrary, caller-supplied implementation address.
Low-level implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) executed inside _fallback with attacker-controlled calldata.
Target address parameter of delegateTo used as the delegatecall target.
Raw bytes parameter of delegateTo used as the delegatecall payload.
New implementation address parameter of _setImplementation written into the implementation state variable.
Local variable in _setImplementation caching the previous implementation address for the NewImplementation event.
Constructor parameter timelock_ forwarded to the initialize delegatecall.
Constructor parameter forth_ forwarded to the initialize delegatecall.
Constructor parameter admin_ assigned to the admin state variable at the end of construction.
Constructor parameter implementation_ used as delegatecall target and passed to _setImplementation.
Constructor parameter votingPeriod_ encoded into the initialize delegatecall.
Constructor parameter votingDelay_ encoded into the initialize delegatecall.
Constructor parameter proposalThreshold_ encoded into the initialize delegatecall.
Local tuple (success, returnData) of the low-level delegatecall result used for revert/return logic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the admin state variable in the constructor, making the deployer the initial privileged account.
msg.sender is compared against admin in the require of _setImplementation, controlling who may upgrade the implementation.
The admin state variable gates execution of the _setImplementation upgrade path.
The implementation_ parameter is written into the implementation state variable, redirecting all future delegatecalls.
oldImplementation is read from the implementation state variable before it is overwritten.
The callee parameter flows into the delegatecall target inside delegateTo.
The data parameter flows into the delegatecall payload inside delegateTo.
Function delegateTo contains and executes the low-level delegatecall unsafe operation.
Function _fallback contains and executes the implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) unsafe operation.
fallback() forwards execution to the internal _fallback() function.
receive() forwards execution to the internal _fallback() function.
The constructor calls delegateTo to run the implementation initialize function.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to store the initial implementation address.
Constructor parameter implementation_ is used as the delegatecall target inside delegateTo.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter callee only exists to feed the delegatecall target and should be folded into the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
Parameter data is only the delegatecall payload and should be absorbed into the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
Parameter implementation_ belongs exclusively to _setImplementation and should be merged into that function node.
Local variable oldImplementation is used only inside _setImplementation and should be merged into that function node.
Constructor parameter timelock_ is only forwarded during construction and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter forth_ is only forwarded during construction and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter admin_ is only used to set the admin state variable in the constructor and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter implementation_ is consumed by the constructor's delegatecall and _setImplementation call and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter votingPeriod_ is only encoded into the initialize call and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter votingDelay_ is only encoded into the initialize call and should be merged into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter proposalThreshold_ is only encoded into the initialize call and should be merged into the constructor node.
Local tuple success_returnData holds the raw result of the fallback delegatecall and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
